metadata.notes: Web-discovered reference (Step 0). Live aircraft-tracking console (tar1090-style globe UI). Analysis produced by the external vision service (scripts/vision-call.sh: full-image glance, region crops, targeted verify pass, input-form pass) plus pixel-exact measurement (scripts/analyze-ui.py, scripts/measure-accent2.py, direct BMP pixel sampling) — measurement only sharpens vision-derived values, never substitutes for them.

theme.notes: Values measured from THIS reference only. Dominant UI chrome (right sidebar panel surface) is a neutral dark gray #313131 (pixel-modal; vision concurs, explicitly NOT navy). The main canvas is a darkened tactical map — its flat-color analog for the shell canvas is a darker neutral #262626 so the #313131 card surfaces pop against it. Accent family is steel blue→cyan: table row fill #2A5363 (hue ~197°, modal of 131,984 sampled px), table header / toolbar button band #064B75 (modal of the blue bucket), lighter blue-gray borders #4388A0, link text #4873A8. #5D9AB8 is the UI-durable lift of that steel-cyan family for accents/text; #4A7D96 its dim. Text: #D8D8D8 primary (measured row-text mode), #BFBFBF secondary (counts line), #858585 muted/labels. Semantic hues read from the reference's own altitude legend + aircraft coloring: green #00C83C, yellow #FFE500, red #F00000, blue #2364E8, cyan #00C8D8. No glow/neon anywhere in the reference — flat utilitarian chrome.

frame.notes: The reference draws NO outer page frame: the sidebar surface meets the map directly with no drawn border line. For the shell, bar cells get a minimal 1px hairline in the chrome family (#3F3F3F, a tone just above the #313131 surface, kin to the measured #242424 internal lines) purely to separate the eDEX bar cells; no radius, no glow.

cards.notes: Widgets/cards are flat rectangles: #313131 fill, square corners (cornerRounding detected:false, radius 0), no shadow/glow, separated by 1px #242424 hairlines (the measured dark internal band around the table header region). Internal section bands inside a card are divided by the same #242424 hairlines.

dividers.notes: 1px dark hairlines: table row separators alternate #2A5363 rows against #313131 gaps; header region bounded by #242424 lines. The table header itself is a filled steel-blue band #064B75.

inputs.notes: Search/jump input fields: dark flat rectangles, fill ~#1C1C1C (vision; pixel scan found the dark input runs in the form region), 1px mid-gray border #858585 (measured #858585 text/border tone), square corners.

activeIndicators.notes: The reference's active language is a FILLED band, not a left accent bar: active Search tab and toolbar buttons are solid steel-blue fills (#064B75 modal) with 1px #4388A0 lighter borders; the selected aircraft table row is highlighted with an amber fill #60572E (measured 1,514 px mode in the table region). eDEX treeitem active state maps to a filled steel-blue band + accent text; no bracket, no glow.
